CU46PaidRefused.dc.html.note: Final check at 621798bf: strict diff (threshold 8) and re-tapped. The board state is pixel exact, and cash Fix it now opens as CU35 is drawn: All 300,000, They gave 420,000 chosen, pays now 300,000, Give change 120,000. It records 300,000 with over:'change', Paid shows change 120,000, the receipt goes and the list shows 3 owe. Throw it away / Undo / Take it again work. Two bugs on the paths the builder did not test. (1) Fix it → Mobile (with ID) or → Bank records momo or bank 300,000 correctly, but Paid still reads 'Cash' with no ID or ref, because the Paid entry keeps the kept payment's method. Fix: when Fix it commits (the retryKept branch in Pay.tsx), write the new method, ref, change, given, deposit and lines into the Paid entry, and keep them when onKeptSent fires. (2) A Mobile payment kept → refused → Fix it records 300,000 momo with change 120,000, and Paid reads 'Give change now · they gave 0 · 120,000'. Same fix as CU41 ('they sent 420,000'). Note: likelyNotes(300,000) offers 305,000 · 310,000 (the core rule; the lead's note).

CU47PaidThrownAway.dc.html.note: Final check at 621798bf: strict diff (threshold 8) and re-tapped. The state is reached by taps (refused → Throw it away). The figures, card, Undo and 'Still owes 300,000' match. Three things fail. (1) Visible: the board's toast has a 1 px ring (box-shadow 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.12)) so it stands off the navy. The app's shared toast has none, so on navy it has no edge. Fix in the shared part (src/ui/toast.css .ow-toast, and P28 in LANGUAGE): add that ring to the toast's shadow (it is invisible on light ground), via the shared-parts agent. (2) 'Take it again' opens a plain Take payment (owes 300,000, They gave Exact · 305,000 · 310,000): the 420,000 she holds is not offered, so she cannot give the 120,000 change in that screen. Fix: open it the way Fix it does, with They gave = the thrown payment's amount and method. (3) The 'Thrown away · Undo' toast stays over the next screen after Take it again; an Undo there would restore the refused write while a new payment is being taken. Close the toast when Paid is left.
